verdict.rationale: Expensify's travel page says employees can book flights, hotels, cars and rail in-platform as part of a corporate travel management solution, so the booking half of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows travel policy being enforced when the trip is booked, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of travel-policy enforcement at booking time (e.g., out-of-policy blocking, pre-trip approvals, fare/hotel caps), in-depth travel docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the booking flow.
